segments.text: You buy the expensive car so people will think you're impressive. Here's the sad little secret.
Nobody's looking at you. They see the car, and they picture themselves in it. You're not even in the frame.
It's the man-in-the-car paradox. The stuff you buy to earn respect almost never earns it.
The people you're trying to impress are too busy wanting that same respect for themselves.
Buy it for you, not for them. Full verdict on the channel.
